integrity: The proof is self-contained after the operator definition: diagonal blocks are restricted Hilbert transforms, off-diagonal blocks are dominated by restricted Carleman operators, and a weighted Schur calculation gives the constant pi. The current primary source was inspected through its sharpness discussion, general theorem, refined Dini/Besov estimates, and bounded-variation inclusion. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The bound is uniform in the commutator order only when the number of affine pieces is fixed; it does not rule out polynomial order-growth for infinitely cornered Lipschitz profiles or for families whose number of pieces grows with the order. The factor pi*N is not claimed sharp.
title: Finite-corner Calderón commutators have no polynomial-in-order loss
